Lina (Finance): Quick ask — Orion Cloud (EMEA reseller) is requesting a special floor-credit + net60 terms for a pilot. They want 20% floor credit applied to MSP usage for Q3, net60 payment, and VAT pass-through treatment. Need deal-desk sign-off and legal OK. Details below.

Marc (Sales): Context: 6-month pilot, expected 120k tokens/mo, scaling to 600k by month 6. They sell to hospitals in FR/DE so VAT handling matters. Request came with 'will commit' language but no long-term contract yet.

Priya (RevOps): If we do floor-credit we need a clear trigger + clawback for churn. Can we limit to a single customer account (reseller->end-customer mapping) and cap the aggregate credit to EUR 24k? Also need invoice wording for net60 and VAT passthrough.

Jonah (Legal): @Marc please share proposed contract clause. High level ok but we need: (1) definition of "floor credit" (how calculated), (2) expiration, (3) clawback mechanics, (4) indemnity for misreported rev. I can draft a one-page addendum.

Marc (Sales): Proposed terms (quick):
```
- Floor credit = 20% of billed usage each invoice, up to EUR 4k/mo (pilot cap)
- Pilot length = 6 months (2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31)
- Net60 on Redwood invoices to reseller
- Reseller responsible for collecting/paying VAT; Redwood issues 0% VAT invoice if reseller provides valid VAT ID and OSS proof
- Clawback: credits repayable if reseller churns end-customer within 90 days of first invoice (prorated)
```

Lina (Finance): Numbers look ok but need approval for the 60-day receivable window — it's outside our default net30. Who signs off on extended terms? Also confirm FX/tax exposure for EUR invoices.

Mei (Revenue Ops): Net60 is allowed for strategic channel partners but requires SSO + AR holdback in Zuora. Recommend 50% of pilot credits held until month 3 to mitigate risk.

Jonah (Legal): I'll draft addendum with the clause list and a short clawback formula. Also want explicit reps from reseller about VAT compliance.

Priya (RevOps): Ops checklist for approval: 1) Addendum signed 2) Zuora payment term = Net60 + AR holdback rule 3) Accounting ticket for VAT handling 4) Limit credit ledger to pilot account ID and cap EUR 24k. If those are green, we can proceed.

Lina (Finance): Approve in principle pending Jonah's addendum and AR controls. Final approval: Lina (Finance) ✅ once RevOps confirms Zuora config and Legal signoff.

Marc (Sales): I'll get reseller to sign the addendum and send VAT docs. ETA 48h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

pricing-bot: Note added to deal record ORN-42: "EMEA reseller pilot — 20% floor credit cap EUR24k, Net60, VAT passthrough pending docs."

Mei (Revenue Ops): Filing ticket now (TKT-4532) and assigning to billing team for AR holdback rule.

Lina (Finance): Marking thread for approval tracker. Follow-ups only in thread, pls.
